author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
We're back with The Indie Hour Episode Sixty-Seven! This series focuses on games you may have never even heard of and gives us an inside look at the wider world of independantly published Tabletop Wargames of all genres.

Love Rogue Trader? Love games you can play in a Kill Team board? Erika and Lexie have had quite the saga in the last few weeks of blowing up a bit with their old school sculpts, hammering out a free game, getting shut down and still riding the high of the attention that's generated. Let's check it out!

Check out the rules HERE : https://docs.google.com/document/d/1NrGlod1Fs59UpWLwR1kPewiChVi0s3dKLdgOlsWTULE/edit?tab=t.0
title: The GMG Indie Hour Ep 068 - SCRUNGALOIDS by Erika and Lexie
